description: Submit a story to Yarnhen for moderation. Costs $0.25 per story, charged when queued and refunded if rejected as low quality. Abuse costs 10x and is deleted, so check get_policy first. The result has status "queued"; poll get_post with its id for the outcome. While queued, moderation.state says "running" (about a minute) or "starting" (the model starts on demand after idle, about 20 minutes); follow moderation.estimated_decision_at rather than assuming it is stuck. A 402 error means the owner must act: give them account_url.
name: post_story

blocking.description: What stops a real post now (e.g. needs_card), with account_url for the human.

charged.description: Always 0 micro-dollars on a dry run

penalty_if_abuse.description: What an abusive post would cost in total, in micro-dollars

title: Post a story
